parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Before you invoke this operation, the instance must be in the Running state. You can invoke the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation and check the DBInstanceStatus field in the response to confirm the current state of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。调用本接口前，实例须处于Running状态，您可以通过调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口返回的DBInstanceStatus字段确认实例当前状态
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shard or mongos node in the sharded cluster instance.

If the instance is a sharded cluster instance and this parameter is not specified, the entire sharded cluster instance is restarted
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点ID或Mongos节点ID。

当实例类型为分片集群实例时，如不传入本参数，则重启分片集群实例
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and inventory. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false: sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the operation is directly performed. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The time when the instance is restarted. Valid values:
0: restarts the instance immediately.
1: restarts the instance within the O&M window
parameters.help_zh:
重启实例的时间点。取值：
0：立即切换。
1：在可运维时间段内切换
parameters.name: switch_mode

parameters.help_en:
The type of the node to be restarted in the sharded cluster instance. Valid values:
db: shard node.
mongos: mongos node.
cs: Configserver node
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中待重启节点的类型。取值：
db：Shard节点。
mongos：Mongos节点。
cs：Configserver节点
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restart mongos nodes in parallel. This parameter takes effect only when multiple mongos nodes are restarted at a time
parameters.help_zh: 是否并行重启Mongos节点。改参数仅当批量重启Mongos节点时生效
parameters.name: parallel_restart_mongos
